title: 来自月亮的 Z · 第一章白天设定
titleEn: Z, from the Moon · Chapter 1 daytime studies

englishExample.title: 对话界面 · 英文示例

screens.title: 白天自由探索
screens.purpose: 查看白天探索的角色比例、路径与行动入口；普通行走不扣游戏时间，具体活动另行预告耗时。
screens.purposeEn: Review character scale, paths and action entry points. Walking does not advance game time; activities show their own time cost.
screens.alt: 第一章白天自由探索的静态游戏界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of daytime exploration in Chapter 1

screens.title: 小岛地图
screens.purpose: 对照当前位置、地点与通路信息；本页 M 键仅切到地图设定图，不执行游戏导航或移动。
screens.purposeEn: Review location markers and routes. Here, M only opens this map study; it does not navigate or move a game character.
screens.alt: 标注地点与通路的小岛地图静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static island map UI study with locations and routes

screens.title: 码头问询
screens.purpose: 查看公开信息与人物问询的呈现；读到公告与完成来源核验分别成立，图中记录不代表已执行任务。
screens.purposeEn: Review public information and enquiries. Reading a notice is separate from verifying a source; pictured records do not mean a task was executed.
screens.alt: 码头人物问询与信息入口的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of enquiries and information at the dock

screens.title: 咖啡馆工作
screens.purpose: 对照班次窗口、行动结束时间与金币报酬；工作确认前应看清代价，预览工资不等于已经到账。
screens.purposeEn: Review shift windows, finish times and gold rewards. Costs should be clear before confirmation; a reward preview is not a completed payment.
screens.alt: 咖啡馆班次与工作确认的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of café shifts and work confirmation

screens.title: 咖啡馆购买
screens.purpose: 查看商品、金币价格与持有数量；白天购买进入库存，夜间送出已有礼物时不再重复扣金币。
screens.purposeEn: Review items, gold prices and owned quantities. Daytime purchases enter inventory; sending an owned gift at night does not charge gold again.
screens.alt: 咖啡馆商品与金币购买信息的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of café items and gold purchase information

screens.title: 道具间场务
screens.purpose: 查看正常场务、物品交接与公开工作范围；工作许可不自动开放私人后台，也不表示已与 Z 私下见面。
screens.purposeEn: Review regular stage duties, item handovers and permitted work areas. Work access does not grant private backstage access or a private meeting with Z.
screens.alt: 道具间正常场务与物品交接的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of props room duties and item handovers

screens.title: 灯塔权限边界
screens.purpose: 对照灯塔外围、门禁与受限区域提示；发现入口不等于取得进入许可，首章不提前解锁内部路径。
screens.purposeEn: Review the lighthouse exterior, access gate and restricted-area cues. Finding the entrance does not grant permission or unlock its interior in Chapter 1.
screens.alt: 灯塔外围门禁与权限提示的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of the lighthouse exterior and access restrictions

screens.title: 人物对话
screens.purpose: 查看说话对象、已知信息与行动选项的排版；选择、耗时和结果须分别呈现。右上另有本屏英文示例。
screens.purposeEn: Review speakers, known information and action choices. Choices, time costs and outcomes are distinct. An English example of this screen is linked above.
screens.alt: 人物对话内容与可选行动的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of character dialogue and available actions

screens.title: 背包与物品
screens.purpose: 对照持有物、数量与用途信息；持有、借用、交付分别成立。本页 I 键只切换设定图，不操作库存。
screens.purposeEn: Review owned items, quantities and uses. Ownership, borrowing and delivery are distinct. Here, I changes the study image without modifying inventory.
screens.alt: 背包物品、持有数量与用途说明的静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static backpack UI study with items, quantities and descriptions

screens.title: 夜间手机直播
screens.purpose: 对照白天与夜间共用的字号层级、面板样式与礼物资产，检查 C.02 风格在昼夜界面中的一致性。
screens.purposeEn: Compare shared typography, panel styling and gift assets across daytime and nighttime screens, checking consistency with the C.02 direction.
screens.alt: 白发 Z 的夜间手机直播静态界面设定
screens.altEn: Static UI study of white-haired Z’s nighttime phone stream
